title: The Loyal friend of the family
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：loyal　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 loyal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the farmer wrote of ① a loyal friend of the family in the almanac, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② so loyal that nobody in the field would go near it. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the farmer, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the loyal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the loyal friend of the family that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac for September 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too loyal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the loyal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a loyal dog at the gate, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as loyal as the dog at the gate they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was loyal or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was ⑦ something loyal, and nothing besides. The child from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite loyal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the almanac kept the names of the loyal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, with great care, she wrote of another loyal friend of the family in the same almanac, and the work, which took two autumns, seemed ⑨ no less loyal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The loyal dog at the gate that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the loyal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 忠诚（前置定语 a loyal friend of the family：1959 年农人在农事历里记下的那件忠诚的朋友）
B. adj. 忠诚／忠心（两处加强说法：so loyal that … 与 no less loyal than …）
C. adj. 忠诚／忠心（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 忠诚（表语 too loyal to do：母亲觉得它太忠诚，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 忠心（前置定语 a loyal dog at the gate：叔叔把整件事称作一桩忠心的狗）
F. adj. 忠心（同级比较 as loyal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩守门忠心的狗相比）
G. adj. 忠心（后置定语 something loyal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 忠心（受程度副词修饰 quite loyal：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a loyal friend of the family
the loyal friend of the family that
a loyal dog at the gate
The loyal dog at the gate that

answers.why: loyal 意为“忠诚”，1959 年农人在农事历里记下的是“一件忠诚的朋友”，此处作前置定语 a loyal friend of the family。
loyal 意为“忠诚”，此处用 so loyal that 结构，说它忠诚到田垄里没人敢靠近。
loyal 意为“忠诚”，农事历上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的忠诚家里忠实的朋友，等于最高级的说法。
loyal 意为“忠诚”，母亲认为这件东西“太忠诚了，谁也用不上”，too loyal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
loyal 意为“忠心”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩忠心的狗”，此处作前置定语 a loyal dog at the gate。
loyal 意为“忠心”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩守门忠心的狗一样忠心”，同级比较用 as loyal as。
loyal 意为“忠心”，农事历上那半行字要的是“忠心的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something loyal。
loyal 意为“忠心”，邻田垄来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当忠心”，quite 修饰原级 loyal。
loyal 意为“忠心”，no less loyal than 表示“其忠心不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之忠心不亚于任何人的预料。
loyal 意为“忠心”，母亲 1971 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的忠心狗”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，农人在农事历里记下了一件忠诚的朋友。（a loyal friend of the family）
它忠诚到田垄里没有一个人敢靠近。（so loyal that …）
母亲觉得它太忠诚，谁也用不上。（too loyal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩忠心的狗。（a loyal dog at the gate）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩守门忠心的狗一样忠心。（as loyal as …）
到了 1966 年，农事历上只剩半行字：要的是一件忠心的东西。（something loyal）
answers: In 1959 the farmer wrote of a loyal friend of the family in the almanac.
It was so loyal that nobody in the field would go near it.
My mother thought it too loyal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a loyal dog at the gate.
He said nobody would call it as loyal as the dog at the gate they had once had.
By 1966 the almanac asked for nothing but something loyal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 loyal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the farmer wrote of a loyal friend of the family in the almanac, and nobody forgot it.
It was the loyal friend of the family that anybody there had ever seen, or so the almanac says.
My mother thought it too loyal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a loyal dog at the gate, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next field called the plan quite loyal, and everybody laughed.
The loyal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
